data.body: FYI from the A1 landing session: both Windows sweeps after 79f46cde8a4 still fail 8 tests in tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.py with `SnapshotError: git checkout-index ... unable to create file ...\rebar-gate-snapshots\tmp\c-<hash>\.rebar/cache/plan-review/<id>/<64-hex>.json: Filename too long`. The 8 are test_code_drift_in_dependency_file_invalidates, test_drift_refresh_reuses_on_immaterial_drift, test_refreshed_attestation_rebinds_to_current_code, test_drift_refresh_escalates_on_probe_finding, test_progressive_drift_refresh_always_takes_probe, test_drift_refreshed_attestation_carries_a_verified_at_sha, test_container_unrelated_commit_does_not_invalidate and test_container_child_declared_file_drift_invalidates. Seen in job 135569438854 (run 44526811291, main f8e9ea0e61f) and job 135597358757 (run 44534782876, main fa383b1d195). max-path.args no longer exists on main, so they keep the sweep red.
